measurement_notes: final_kv_bytes is measured at the end of each successful generation, not peak KV memory over time.
Full/KIVI/SnapKV/PyramidKV: unique backing-storage bytes of tracked cache tensors; includes stored metadata and retained capacity.
PhaseKV: unique tracked packed KV storage including quantization metadata, allocated pages and hot capacity; excludes decode workspace.
MILLION: key/value codes and residual tensor bytes; not total allocator memory, codebooks or attention workspace.
ClusterKV: tracked GPU kv_cache tensor bytes; CPU pinned KV is separate; centroids/other auxiliaries are not included in final_kv_bytes.
Prefill/decode peaks include model weights and other PyTorch allocations; they are not KV-only measurements.
OOM has no successful final KV value. Missing values are never replaced with zero.
End-to-end throughput is recomputed per run as B * generated_tokens / (TTFT + decode_s), then median; excludes model loading.
Four GPUs ran concurrently; protocols preserve physical UUID and source settings.

notes: Quality uses 320 selected full LongBench documents, 48 LongGenBench compound prompts and 64 RULER32K cases per method, B1.
No old cropped LongBench records are included; reused records have matching complete input hashes.
Mean scores exclude OOM/unsupported; paired delta uses the same successful cases for method and Full.
LongGenBench main score is the mean over 48 prompts; question-weighted and indexed diagnostics are separate.
Speed compares concurrent runs on different physical A800s; do not claim controlled same-card speedup.
Historical queue and summary statuses may be stale; raw records plus single-card state establish completion.
